agent_summary: The Gravity Weighted Blanket was verified on the vendor's official website, including the requested 20 lb option. All claimed safety features were corroborated by the product documentation, which confirms evenly distributed fine-grade glass beads in gridded stitching, a breathable removable cover, and weight sizing calibrated to roughly 10% of body weight. The item is an allowable sensory support and does not fall under any OTPS exclusion categories. Reviewer attention is directed to pricing: while the regular price of $199.00 matches the application, the vendor is currently running a 25% discount bringing the published purchase price to $149.00.
checklist_notes: Approval is valid for 3 months, then resubmit.
